metadata.interpretation: Observed-envelope heuristic, not firmware safety proof; types are invisible but hidden-state/transient bounds remain unknown.

preampPolicy.floorReason: S1 compact format, still strictly positive Q23 word; usability floor rather than measured chip boundary

sweep.passFiltersGainNote: LP/HP have no gain parameter; each f/Q cell evaluated once, equivalent to every ignored gain label.

loudness.method: Unweighted arithmetic mean dB on the official 280-point log frequency lattice restricted to 300–3000 Hz; includes Q23 preamp and Q27 response.
loudness.unknownCurrentPolicy: Always warn when current on-cable curve is unknown: browser localStorage is not readback.
